title: Modules
explain: A module is a named group of packages, declared in a `module-info.java` file at the root of its source. `requires` lists the modules you depend on, and `exports` lists the packages other modules may use. Modules make dependencies explicit, though many applications still run fine on the classpath.
exercise: Split a small app into two modules, with one module exporting a package that the other requires.
tip: Code in a package that is not exported is hidden from other modules, even when its classes are public.
